_comment: X-AGE, the extra batch's AGE look-alikes (D-64d, m2; red-team rule #136: v4.2 masks any number next to `yaş` as AGE). Merged over quotas.json: every document is an age pair (decoy_pair, group age); age_v43.rate of them put a real age of a person with `yaş` beside a number next to `yaş` that is not a person's age (frames_v43.AGE_LOOKALIKES), unlabelled; the rest keep D-57 S1's age pairs. Run: build_targeted_corpus.py -n 400 --seed <s> --quotas scripts/piigen/targeted/quotas_x_age.json -o <out>. Not with --stats (a one-family run lacks a full build's protected kinds).
_frame_cap_comment: max_frame_share 0.06 of this batch: one family only, appended to v4.2's 142k train
